excludedAssessments.summary: The internal marginalization, posterior-measure/Carathéodory, Q0 witness, coercive-bound, and inversion arguments are plausible and largely algebraically sound. However, the record does not establish that the reconstructed 30-row functional and side conditions exactly match Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9, equations (19a)–(19p), or that the stated optimization order defining B(G,K) is correct. Because no reference transaction was declared, the external manuscript and source artifacts cannot supply these missing premises. Thus all four mathematical assertions remain conditional on an unverified model-identification premise, and the included provenance assertions are also unverified.
scopeQualifications: The input-only, conditionally independent replacement is established only if every actual theorem term involving G or K has the asserted single-receiver form.
The at-most-N-output reduction is established only for a grid-restricted functional determined solely by the preserved mutual-information samples.
The exact Q0 optimum and coercive bound are established only for the reconstructed row model, not conclusively for the named external Theorem 9 functional.
No decisive counterexample or internal algebraic contradiction was identified.
The claims that artifacts are verbatim accepted submissions and exact checker copies are not verified.
evidenceIssues: No declared reference evidence establishes the exact contents of Theorem 9 equations (19a)–(19p), their branches, or their side conditions.
The asserted complete term audit and correspondence of the hard-coded 30-row system to the external theorem are not independently established.
The formal definition and optimization order of B(G,K), needed for B(G,K)≥V(1/2;G,K)≥V0(g,k), are not supplied as admitted evidence.
There is no attested execution on pinned checker bytes; execution would in any event validate only the generated row system, not its correspondence to the external theorem.
No source comparison or content-addressed attestation supports the provenance and prior-acceptance assertions.

excludedAssessments.summary: The capacity bound, repaired predecessor certificate, zero-backoff assertion, and invariant-frontier representation are not fully established by the bounded record. The indispensable applicability and transcription of the Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 converse are unsupported because no reference transaction is declared, and the interval and exact-rational verifiers lack trusted execution attestations. Conditional on the six converse rows and successful verifier runs, the weak-duality architecture, martingale relaxation, coefficient cancellation, symmetry/concavity maximization at prior 1/2, rounding implication, and numerical strict-improvement comparison are coherent. No decisive counterexample or contradiction is shown.
scopeQualifications: The new capacity conclusion is established only conditionally on validity and applicability of the six asserted Theorem 9 rows, including the rate-free side condition, for the fixed pair G,K and every achievable hierarchy.
The quoted enclosure would imply C_sum <= 0.369296945969202842443, but the continuous interval computation is not affirmatively established by trusted execution evidence.
The quoted final endpoint is numerically below the quoted repaired endpoint, but validity of both certificates remains unresolved.
Nonnegativity of the displayed invariant weights, the normalization 2s_B+s_C+s_D+s_E=1, and the stated quotient coordinates by substitution are directly supported.
The provenance assertions about accepted, verbatim artifacts are not mathematical prerequisites and are not established by source-object or digest evidence.
evidenceIssues: No declared reference establishes the content, side conditions, transcription, or applicability of the Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 outer bound.
There is no trusted terminal attestation that the final fail-closed interval checker passed or produced the quoted 80-digit enclosure and coverage results.
The very small tangent margin and the directed inequalities used by the adaptive continuous cover are not independently evaluated in the supplied record.
The repaired predecessor checker likewise lacks trusted execution evidence, and the claimed strictly negative zero-intercept gap is reported rather than terminally established.
The exact-rational invariant verifier lacks trusted execution attestation.

The skew-pair ordering, mapping from pair weights to the named rank-eight quotient, and status of the additional invariant rows under Theorem 9 are asserted or hard-coded rather than independently derived.
